target.title: Installed ndx can drive a Tetris creation task in an isolated sandbox
target.test: A separate filesystem sandbox installs @neurondev/ndx@0.1.40 from Verdaccio and uses the installed bins to run a simple Tetris project creation acceptance flow.

steps.instruction: Create a clean temporary sandbox outside the repository and install @neurondev/ndx@0.1.40 from Verdaccio there.
steps.expected: The sandbox contains an npm global prefix with ndx and ndxserver bins reporting version 0.1.40.

steps.instruction: In the sandbox, create a minimal Tetris game project through the installed Node/npm toolchain and installed ndx availability check.
steps.expected: The Tetris project contains HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files with game loop, board, piece movement, rotation, line clearing, score, and next-piece UI.

steps.instruction: Run automated checks against the sandbox Tetris files.
steps.expected: Checks confirm required files exist and contain the expected gameplay and UI hooks.

target.passCriteria: The isolated sandbox install works and the Tetris acceptance project passes its automated checks.

target.instruction: Create a clean temporary sandbox outside the repository and install @neurondev/ndx@0.1.40 from Verdaccio there.
target.expected: The sandbox contains an npm global prefix with ndx and ndxserver bins reporting version 0.1.40.

steps.descript: Verdaccio install could not run because @neurondev/ndx@0.1.40 was not published; the equivalent local tarball install passed.
evidence: npm install -g @neurondev/ndx@0.1.40 from Verdaccio returned ETARGET.

target.instruction: In the sandbox, create a minimal Tetris game project through the installed Node/npm toolchain and installed ndx availability check.
target.expected: The Tetris project contains HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files with game loop, board, piece movement, rotation, line clearing, score, and next-piece UI.

steps.descript: The isolated sandbox contains a Tetris project with the required files and gameplay hooks.

target.instruction: Run automated checks against the sandbox Tetris files.
target.expected: Checks confirm required files exist and contain the expected gameplay and UI hooks.

steps.descript: Automated file checks passed for the generated Tetris project.
evidence: Node verification returned result true for semantic main, next-piece UI, board dimensions, movement, rotation, line clearing, and game loop.

result.descript: Tetris acceptance passes for the corrected local package tarball, but the required Verdaccio install cannot pass until the registry accepts 0.1.40.
evidence: Local tarball install and Tetris checks passed.
Verdaccio install failed because @neurondev/ndx@0.1.40 is not available in the registry.
